name: hmog
paper_title: HMOG: New Behavioral Biometric Features for Continuous Authentication of Smartphone Users
authors: Zdenka Sitova, Jaroslav Sedenka, Qing Yang, Ge Peng, Gang Zhou, Paolo Gasti, Kiran S. Balagani
venue: IEEE Transactions on Information Forensics and Security, 11(5), 877-892
license: Non-exclusive, non-transferable, revocable license for non-commercial educational and research use only; redistribution and re-identification are prohibited.
notes: 100 participants, nominally 24 Samsung Galaxy S4 phone-use sessions each. Reading, writing, and map-navigation tasks were performed sitting or walking. Accelerometer, gyroscope, magnetometer, touch, and interaction events were recorded; HALO retains only co-located accelerometer and gyroscope at 100 Hz from the phone held in the hand.
